notes: Full PA education/income analysis: PROC IMPORT XLSX x2 -> clean/standardize zips (PUT z5.) -> PROC SORT -> MERGE (matched + partition) -> PROC UNIVARIATE quartiles -> PROC FORMAT + quartile classification -> PROC MEANS/PROC TABULATE by group -> PROC SGPLOT scatter. Two PROC IMPORT steps replaced with DATA-step DATALINES (self-contained; the shipped runner submits only the script). Grad sample is real PA zip codes/cities/rates from pa_grad_zip_code.xlsx; income sample constructed to match the Zip/mean/Median/Pop columns the script reads (income_zip_code.xlsx in the repo is a 2-byte placeholder). Column names use the plain SAS names PROC IMPORT yields under VALIDVARNAME=V7; all downstream analysis logic, thresholds, and procs preserved verbatim.
